user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the floating menu links on the page so that I can access different sections of the website easily. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the 'Home' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
2. When I click the 'News' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
3. When I click the 'Contact' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
4. When I click the 'About' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
5. When I click the 'Elemental Selenium' link, I should be redirected to 'http://elementalselenium.com/'.
